metric_candidates.business_definition: 模拟条款 POL-SALES-001-销售口径与订单确认 §3.3（UNREVIEWED，非微软官方业务规则）。底层为微软公开示例库 AdventureWorks OLTP，非真实生产企业数据。

metric_candidates.amount_field_scope_note: 使用订单头 TerritoryID 关联 SalesTerritory，属订单归属区域口径；不得改用 Customer.TerritoryID。

metric_candidates.name: 低于再订货点商品数
metric_candidates.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "ProductID", SUM("Quantity") AS qty FROM "Production.ProductInventory" GROUP BY "ProductID") inv JOIN "Production.Product" p ON inv."ProductID"=p."ProductID" WHERE inv.qty < p."ReorderPoint"

metric_candidates.amount_field_scope_note: 按 (ProductID, StartDate) 的历史区间成本，EndDate IS NULL 表示当前有效；不可用 Product.StandardCost 替代。
metric_candidates.business_definition: 模拟条款 POL-COST-002-历史成本匹配 §3.5（UNREVIEWED，非微软官方业务规则）。底层为微软公开示例库 AdventureWorks OLTP，非真实生产企业数据。
metric_candidates.formula_complete: SELECT CAST("StandardCost" AS REAL) FROM "Production.ProductCostHistory" WHERE "ProductID" = :product AND "StartDate" <= :event AND ("EndDate" IS NULL OR :event < "EndDate")
metric_candidates.name: 历史标准成本
metric_candidates.reference_sql: SELECT "ProductID", "StartDate", "EndDate", CAST("StandardCost" AS REAL) AS cost FROM "Production.ProductCostHistory" WHERE "ProductID"=707 ORDER BY "StartDate"
unresolved_business_questions: 按订单日期匹配时必须限定 StartDate <= OrderDate < EndDate，区间边界开闭需人工确认。

metric_candidates.amount_field_scope_note: SalesYTD 是系统预置快照，与配额历史 1:N 关联会重复；不得与实时订单聚合相加。
metric_candidates.business_definition: 模拟条款 POL-PERF-001-销售绩效与配额 §3.3（UNREVIEWED，非微软官方业务规则）。底层为微软公开示例库 AdventureWorks OLTP，非真实生产企业数据。
metric_candidates.formula_complete: CAST("SalesYTD" AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST("SalesQuota" AS REAL), 0)
metric_candidates.name: 配额达成率
metric_candidates.reference_sql: SELECT sp."BusinessEntityID", CAST(sp."SalesYTD" AS REAL) AS ytd, CAST(q."SalesQuota" AS REAL) AS quota FROM "Sales.SalesPerson" sp JOIN "Sales.SalesPersonQuotaHistory" q ON sp."BusinessEntityID"=q."BusinessEntityID" ORDER BY sp."BusinessEntityID" LIMIT 5
unresolved_business_questions: 配额应按期取最新还是按区间匹配未审核。
快照与实时聚合混用是明确风险。
